items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I think their leader's name was Napoleon, as I remember.

ctx.x: Was that very unusual when he started playing with Chick?

No, not really. Not really, because there was another fellow named {Alberto} Socarras. Well, he was a Cuban, I believe, and he played with different bands, like Benny Carter's band and so and so, up at the Savoy, and he used to play the flute. And there were others, there was another band up there -- what was the name of this band? A band called the San Domingans. Yeah, they were from San Domingo, the band, and they were -- I wouldn't say it was a great band, but it was adequate for the Savoy and I think their…
